## What changes

- [ ] Follows the scope of the linked issue (one logical change)
- [ ] Conventional Commits title (`feat:` / `fix:` / `test:` / `docs:` / `chore:` / `refactor:`)

## Gates (must all pass)

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run build` (if touching build-affecting code)

## UI changes

- [ ] Not a UI change, **or**
- [ ] Screenshots attached (before/after) and reduced-motion respected

## Notes for reviewers

<!-- Anything subtle: migrations, env changes, follow-ups -->
